name: brummer-error-tests
description: Test scripts for Brummer TUI error handling

scripts.errors:burst: python3 -c "import sys, time; [print(f'Error {i}: Something went wrong!', file=sys.stderr) or time.sleep(0.1) for i in range(20)]"
scripts.errors:mixed: python3 -c "import sys, time, random; [(print('INFO: Normal output') if random.random() > 0.5 else print('ERROR: Something failed', file=sys.stderr)) or time.sleep(0.5) for _ in range(30)]"
scripts.errors:slow: python3 -c "import sys, time; [print(f'Slow error {i}', file=sys.stderr) or time.sleep(2) for i in range(10)]"
scripts.test:all: echo 'Run each script separately to test different error patterns'
